key: The street dog outside a Chennai tea
name: ch04_tea_stall_street_dog
alt: A friendly street dog outside a Chennai tea stall runs to greet a milkman, an auto driver and two college students, who all smile back at it.
scene: A wide street-level view of a small roadside tea stall in Chennai in the early morning, a steel tea kettle steaming on the counter, glass tumblers lined up, a faded striped awning overhead. In the CENTRE foreground, a brown and white street dog of mixed breed trots forward with its tail wagging in a blur of motion lines, ears up, mouth open in a happy pant, a small dented steel bowl of milk-soaked bread beside its paws. Around it in a loose half-circle stand the regulars: on the LEFT, a milkman (about 50, white vest, checked lungi folded at the knee) steadying a bicycle with two aluminium milk cans, bending down to pat the dog; behind him an auto driver (khaki shirt, moustache) leans on his yellow-and-black auto rickshaw, holding a glass of tea and grinning; on the RIGHT, two college students (a young woman in a salwar kameez with a backpack, a young man in a T-shirt holding a notebook) crouch and laugh as the dog nuzzles their hands. Small floating hearts drift up from each person towards the dog, drawn with dashed lines that all meet at the dog, showing that every one of them is its friend. Nobody is holding out anything for the dog to earn; it simply greets them all. Warm soft morning light, cheerful and gentle mood. One bold label "EVERYONE'S FRIEND" centred across the top of the picture above the awning.

key: A family WhatsApp group after a wedd
name: ch04_wedding_photos_own_face
alt: Three relatives on a sofa each zoom into wedding photos on their phones to look at their own faces, while the bride's uncle in the group photo goes unnoticed.
scene: An indoor living-room scene the evening after an Indian wedding, garlands of marigold still hanging in the doorway, a few gift boxes stacked on a side table. On a long sofa sit three relatives, each absorbed in their own phone: on the LEFT an aunt (about 55, silk sari, reading glasses pushed down her nose), in the MIDDLE a young cousin (early 20s, kurta, earphones around his neck), on the RIGHT a teenage niece (school T-shirt, ponytail). Above each of them hovers a large circular magnifier inset showing their phone screen: a tiny group photo where a single face is circled and enlarged, and in every inset the enlarged face is the viewer's own (the aunt's glasses, the cousin's moustache, the niece's ponytail), so the viewer can see each person is hunting for themselves. A dashed arrow runs from each person's eyes into their own circled face. Across the top of the wall behind them, a big framed group photo of the whole family shows the bride and groom in the middle and a cheerful bride's uncle with a big moustache at the edge; a small grey question mark badge floats beside the uncle because nobody is looking at him. A chat bubble icon with a counter "200" pops from the cousin's phone. Soft lamp light, gently comic mood. One bold label "ME FIRST" in the upper left corner of the picture.

key: Two tuition teachers in the same Kot
name: ch04_kota_two_tutors
alt: Two physics tuition teachers in the same Kota lane: one bored with a nearly empty class, the other warm and enthusiastic as students walk over to join her batch.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, two tuition classrooms side by side in a narrow Kota lane, each with a green chalkboard showing the same simple physics diagram of a ball on a ramp with an arrow. LEFT panel: a male teacher (about 40, grey shirt, spectacles) leans on his desk with arms crossed and a tired, flat expression; his thought bubble shows a stack of notebooks with a red cross over them. Only two students sit on the benches, slouched, one yawning. RIGHT panel: a female teacher (about 35, mustard kurta, chalk in hand) faces her class with an open, bright smile and leans forward; her thought bubble shows a small family of parents and a child standing beside a clay piggy bank with a heart above it, meaning these families are paying from their savings. Her benches are full of upright, engaged students. Along the bottom of the picture, two students with school bags carry their notebooks from the left room towards the right room, with a long dashed arrow running from left to right under their feet to show students switching batches. Both chalkboards are identical to show the syllabus is the same. Even daylight, clear contrast between dull and lively. Labels: "BORED" at the top of the left panel, "INTERESTED" at the top of the right panel.

key: A retired railway clerk in Pune join
name: ch04_morning_walkers_clerk
alt: A retired man in a park asks the morning walkers about their grandchildren, jobs and knees, and they gather round him warmly.
scene: A morning scene in a leafy Pune park with a curved paved walking track, a few gulmohar trees and a park bench, soft early sunlight. In the CENTRE, a retired railway clerk (about 68, white kurta-pyjama, cream cap, round spectacles, a walking stick hooked over one arm) stands not walking fast but chatting, one hand raised in a friendly gesture, head tilted to listen. Around him, the walking group slows down to talk: on the LEFT a grandmother in a sari and sports shoes, on the RIGHT a stocky man in a tracksuit rubbing one knee, and a thin man in a sweater and monkey cap. Above each walker floats a small round bubble with a picture of what the clerk has asked them about: a small baby for the grandmother, a bent knee with a little bandage for the tracksuit man, an old office briefcase for the man in the sweater. Dashed lines connect the clerk to each bubble, showing he remembers each person's life. Two fitter joggers in the background run past quickly, overtaking everyone, but nobody gathers round them. In the upper right corner a small inset bubble shows the same group months later holding clay diyas at a Diwali get-together, the clerk in the middle. Warm hopeful mood. One bold label "ASKS ABOUT YOU" across the top left of the picture.

key: A senior partner at a Gurugram firm
name: ch04_partner_goodbye_staff
alt: On her last day, a senior woman partner says goodbye to the office pantry boy, guard and housekeeping staff, asking the pantry boy about his sister's nursing college.
scene: An interior view of a modern open-plan office in Gurugram in the late afternoon, glass partitions, a row of desks and a small pantry counter with a tea urn on the RIGHT. In the CENTRE-LEFT stands a senior partner (about 50, elegant handloom sari with a dark blazer over it, short grey-streaked hair, a laptop bag on her shoulder and a cardboard box of desk items at her feet showing it is her last day). She leans slightly forward and speaks warmly to the pantry boy (about 19, white uniform shirt, tray of tea cups in his hands), who looks surprised and delighted. A speech bubble from her shows a small white nursing cap with a red cross on it and a question mark, meaning she is asking about his sister's nursing college. Behind them on the RIGHT, a security guard (blue uniform, peaked cap) and a housekeeping woman (green uniform saree, holding a mop) stand smiling; small curved lines from the partner to each of them show she has already greeted them one by one, each with a little name-tag icon above their heads. In the upper right corner, a small inset bubble shows the same pantry, a year later, with the boy telling two colleagues the story over tea. Warm golden window light, touching mood. One bold label "BY NAME" in the upper left of the picture.

key: A medical rep in Lucknow visits a bu
name: ch04_medical_rep_compounder
alt: In a busy clinic, two medical reps rush past the compounder while a third chats with him about his son's cricket, and later the compounder speaks up for him to the grumpy doctor.
scene: A cross-section view of a small busy clinic in Lucknow, wooden benches with waiting patients on the far left, a medicine cupboard and a compounder's small counter in the middle, and a doctor's cabin with a desk on the RIGHT behind a half-open door. On the LEFT, two medical reps in formal shirts and ties, each with a large black bag on wheels, stride straight past the compounder towards the doctor's door, eyes fixed ahead, motion lines behind them. In the CENTRE, a third rep (late 20s, light blue shirt, sleeves rolled, bag set down beside him) stands at the compounder's counter chatting; the compounder (about 45, white coat, moustache) beams, and a bubble between them shows a small boy in white cricket clothes holding a bat. On the RIGHT, the doctor (about 55, spectacles, stethoscope) sits frowning at his desk with arms folded, a small red storm cloud above his head. The compounder leans through the doorway, gesturing towards the friendly rep, with a short speech bubble reading "Sir, he is decent". A green tick appears beside the friendly rep, while the two rushing reps stand outside the closed door. Bright daytime tube light, busy but warm mood. One bold label "GOODWILL" over the compounder's counter.

key: A college fest committee in Kolkata
name: ch04_fest_alumnus_letter
alt: Two invitations to a busy alumnus: a generic request gets a no, while a long letter signed by students with specific questions gets a yes to a video talk.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing the same busy startup founder (about 40, navy blazer over a T-shirt, laptop open) in his office. LEFT panel: a college student messenger hands over a single plain white envelope with one short line of text on it; a small paper flutters away into a dustbin and a large red cross badge floats above it, while an assistant at the side shakes her head politely. The founder does not even look up from his laptop. RIGHT panel: a group of three college students (one in a kurta, one in a T-shirt with a lanyard, one with a jhola bag) unrolls a long paper scroll covered in many tiny signatures, flowing down to the floor; beside it a small card lists five numbered lines with question marks. The founder has turned in his chair, smiling, reading the scroll, and on his laptop screen a small video-call window shows a grid of student faces with a clock icon showing half an hour. A big green tick floats above. Light from a window, a Kolkata tram faintly visible through it. Labels: "GENERIC" at the top of the left panel, "SPECIFIC" at the top of the right panel, and a small "200" on the scroll.

key: A cricketer who dropped the catch th
name: ch04_cricketer_child_letter
alt: A sad cricketer surrounded by angry messages holds one handwritten letter from a young girl, which shows a drawing of him and a heart.
scene: An interior scene of a dim hotel room at night, a cricket kit bag in the corner with a bat sticking out and a crumpled team cap on the bed. In the CENTRE, a professional cricketer (late 20s, team tracksuit, unshaven, shoulders slumped) sits on the edge of the bed. All around him, filling the air like a storm, float many small red speech bubbles with angry exclamation marks and lightning bolts, and a phone on the bed lights up with dozens of red notifications. In his hands, catching the only warm light in the room from a bedside lamp, he holds one sheet of lined school notebook paper written in a child's big handwriting, with a crayon drawing of a cricketer under a heart. He looks down at it with a small, moved smile. A dashed line runs from the letter to a small round inset bubble in the upper right showing a twelve-year-old girl in Indore (school uniform, two plaits) in her bedroom, pointing proudly at a poster of the same cricketer on her wall. The warm lamp light makes a soft circle around the letter while the angry bubbles stay in cool grey-red shadow. Quiet, tender mood. One bold label "ONE LETTER" in the upper left corner of the picture.

key: A Bengaluru team lead moves to a new
name: ch04_team_lead_tamil_lunch
alt: At a team lunch in Chennai, a new team lead tries to order in Tamil and gets it wrong, and the whole table laughs warmly with her.
scene: A cheerful lunch scene in a busy Chennai restaurant at noon, a long table laid with banana leaves holding rice, sambar and small heaps of curry, a steel tumbler of water at each place, a ceiling fan overhead. On the LEFT stands a waiter (white shirt, veshti, small notepad) bending to listen, eyebrows raised in amused surprise. Seated at the head of the table on the LEFT side, the new team lead (about 35, short hair, office kurta with an ID lanyard) leans forward with one finger raised, trying hard; her speech bubble contains a few wobbly squiggle lines with a tiny question mark and a small flipped word-card icon, to show broken words in a new language without any real script. Around the table on the RIGHT sit four team members (a young man in a checked shirt, a woman in a cotton sari, a young woman with spectacles, an older man with a moustache), all laughing openly, one clapping, one wiping a tear of laughter, none mocking. Small curved warm lines and a few hearts rise from the table and wrap around the team lead, showing she has been accepted. In the upper right, a small inset shows a phone with a language-learning flashcard to show the weeks of practice. Bright warm light, friendly mood. One bold label "ONE OF US" across the top of the picture.

key: The chemist near your flat in Hydera
name: ch04_chemist_asks_about_father
alt: A neighbourhood chemist asks a regular customer how his father is doing, while bigger discount pharmacies down the road go unvisited.
scene: A street scene in a Hyderabad neighbourhood in the evening. On the LEFT, a small narrow chemist shop with glass-fronted shelves of medicine boxes and a wooden counter; behind the counter the elderly owner (about 60, white shirt, reading glasses on a cord) leans forward with real concern, holding out a strip of tablets in a small paper bag. His speech bubble shows a small elderly man smiling with a heart and a question mark, meaning he is asking about the customer's father. In front of the counter, a customer (about 30, office shirt, motorbike helmet under one arm) holds a folded prescription and smiles, touched. On the RIGHT, further down the same road, two large brightly lit modern pharmacies with big glass fronts and banners reading "20% OFF" stand almost empty, a bored cashier at each. A long dashed arrow from the customer's parked motorbike curves past the big pharmacies and loops back to the small chemist, showing he keeps coming back. A small green tick floats over the small shop. Warm yellow light from the small shop, cooler white light from the big shops, calm loyal mood. One bold label "STILL HIS SHOP" over the small chemist.

key: You need a sign-off from a strict se
name: ch04_section_officer_chess
alt: In a government office, a visitor chats with a strict officer about chess after noticing a chess trophy photo, and his file moves to the top of the pile.
scene: An interior view of a government office room in Delhi, steel almirahs, a ceiling fan and tall stacks of tied cloth-bound files on a wooden desk. Behind the desk sits a strict section officer (about 55, half-sleeve shirt, spectacles, pen behind his ear); a framed photo on his desk shows a schoolgirl holding a chess trophy, with a small chess king icon. In front of the desk, a visitor (about 35, plain shirt, holding a folder) sits leaning forward, smiling and asking a question. Between them floats a large shared speech bubble showing a chessboard with a knight and king, and the officer, previously stern, is now animated and smiling, hands moving as he explains. On the RIGHT side of the desk, a tall stack of files has one file with a pink tag marked with the visitor's folder colour; a curved arrow shows that file sliding up from near the bottom to the very top of the pile. In the upper left, a small inset bubble shows the first visit: the same officer, stern, palm raised, and a calendar page with an arrow forward, meaning come next week. Afternoon light through a barred window, warm and slightly comic mood. One bold label "COMMON GROUND" across the top of the picture.

key: A small kirana owner in Jaipur has r
name: ch04_kirana_asks_supermarket
alt: A kirana owner asks a supermarket manager how they manage stock, and the delighted manager explains and then offers him a paneer supply deal.
scene: A street view in Jaipur with pink sandstone walls. On the LEFT, a small kirana shop with sacks of rice, jars of sweets and a hanging string of chips packets. On the RIGHT, a big modern supermarket with glass doors, shelves and trolleys visible inside. In the CENTRE, just outside the supermarket doors, the kirana owner (about 55, white kurta, Rajasthani turban, moustache) stands with a humble, curious expression, holding a small notebook and pen, while his teenage nephew (college bag, spectacles) stands behind him. The supermarket manager (about 40, company polo shirt, ID badge, clipboard) gestures enthusiastically towards a stock shelf, explaining with a big pleased smile; dashed arrows from his clipboard to the shelf show the stock system being explained. Above them a small bubble shows a stock chart with boxes moving. A second, larger bubble at the top right shows the next step: the two men shaking hands over a white block of fresh paneer, with a green tick. An old frown cloud above the kirana owner dissolves into small fragments, showing the resentment fading. Bright afternoon light, hopeful mood. One bold label "ASKED, NOT TOLD" across the top left of the picture.

key: A night-shift nurse in a government
name: ch04_onam_nurse_sadya
alt: On Onam night in a half-empty hospital ward, a nurse sits with an old patient and shares her sadya meal on a banana leaf while telling him about her village.
scene: A quiet interior of a government hospital ward in Thiruvananthapuram at night, a long row of iron beds mostly empty with folded sheets, a window on the RIGHT showing a crescent moon and coconut palms. On the floor near the entrance, a small colourful pookalam flower carpet in a circle. In the CENTRE, an old man (about 80, white mundu, thin, white stubble) sits up in his bed, his face lit with a gentle smile. Beside him on a small steel stool sits the night-shift nurse (about 30, white nurse uniform, hair in a bun under a cap) holding a green banana leaf laid across a bedside tray, with small heaps of rice, yellow curry, a papadam and a small banana arranged on it, sharing it between them. Her speech bubble shows a small village scene with a backwater boat and a palm tree, meaning she is telling him about her village. On the LEFT, the empty beds and a dark corridor show how forgotten the ward feels; a small wall clock reads late night. A warm circle of lamp light surrounds the two of them against the blue night shadows of the ward. Tender, quiet mood. One bold label "NOT FORGOTTEN" in the upper left corner of the picture.
